# Every type expression lowers and ejects the same way as a variable type, as an
# alias, as a defined type, and as a generic alias. The ejected module prints the
# same lines as the native build and builds with upstream go1.27.2.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_type_forms.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_type_forms.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/option_type_forms.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/optiontypeforms

go 1.27
